title: Concentration-Dependent Cytotoxicity and DNA Damage Responses of Iohexol in MCF-7 Breast Cancer Cells: An In Vitro and In Silico Study.
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估碘海醇对MCF-7细胞的细胞毒性与DNA损伤，并用分子对接考察其与DNA及蛋白的弱结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系且方法简单，关联度有限。
abstract: Iohexol is a nonionic, low-osmolarity iodinated contrast agent that is widely used in clinical imaging applications. This study evaluated the cytotoxic effects and DNA damage responses of iohexol on the human breast adenocarcinoma cell line (MCF-7) in vitro using MTS and alkaline comet assays. Additionally, molecular docking analyses were performed to complement this approach and investigate the potential interactions of iohexol with DNA, the anti-apoptotic protein BCL-XL, and the metabolic enzyme NUDT5. Iohexol administration caused a concentration-dependent decrease in cell viability, with significant cytotoxicity observed at concentrations of >/= 18.26 mM (p < 0.0001). Comet assay results showed increased DNA damage responses at concentrations above clinical doses, with significant increases detected from 22.8 mM onwards (p < 0.05) and the highest damage levels observed at 91.3-182.6 mM (p < 0.01). Molecular docking analyses revealed that iohexol exhibited weak binding affinity with DNA (-3.57 kcal/mol), showing relatively more pronounced, albeit still moderate, interactions with BCL-XL (-5.25 kcal/mol) and NUDT5 (-5.40 kcal/mol). These findings suggest that iohexol may indirectly interact via pathways associated with cellular stress. In general, the obtained data indicate that iohexol can cause cytotoxicity and DNA damage responses in MCF-7 cells under supra-clinical in vitro exposure conditions. These findings suggest that these effects develop through indirect cellular mechanisms rather than direct DNA binding. This emphasizes the need for careful interpretation of high-dose in vitro data, as well as the need for further mechanistic studies, in order to better understand the cellular effect profile of iohexol. Therefore, the present findings should not be interpreted as direct evidence of genotoxic risk under clinically relevant exposure conditions.
abstract_zh: 碘海醇是一种非离子型、低渗透压的碘化造影剂，广泛应用于临床影像学检查。本研究通过MTS法和碱性彗星实验，在体外评估了碘海醇对人乳腺腺癌细胞系（MCF-7）的细胞毒性效应和DNA损伤反应。此外，进行了分子对接分析以补充该方法，并探究碘海醇与DNA、抗凋亡蛋白BCL-XL及代谢酶NUDT5的潜在相互作用。碘海醇给药导致细胞活力呈浓度依赖性下降，在浓度≥18.26 mM时观察到显著细胞毒性（p < 0.0001）。彗星实验结果显示，在高于临床剂量的浓度下DNA损伤反应增加，从22.8 mM起检测到显著增加（p < 0.05），并在91.3-182.6 mM时观察到最高损伤水平（p < 0.01）。分子对接分析显示，碘海醇与DNA的结合亲和力较弱（-3.57 kcal/mol），与BCL-XL（-5.25 kcal/mol）和NUDT5（-5.40 kcal/mol）的相互作用相对更明显，但仍属中等强度。这些发现表明，碘海醇可能通过与细胞应激相关的通路间接相互作用。总体而言，所得数据表明，在超临床体外暴露条件下，碘海醇可对MCF-7细胞引起细胞毒性和DNA损伤反应。这些发现提示，这些效应是通过间接细胞机制而非直接DNA结合而发展的。这强调了谨慎解读高剂量体外数据的必要性，以及进一步开展机制研究的必要性，以便更好地理解碘海醇的细胞效应谱。因此，本研究发现不应被解释为在临床相关暴露条件下遗传毒性风险的直接证据。
